notes.title: 1.0.3714 update announcement
notes.notes:
1. Update DLSS to the latest version. If you have an RTX graphics card, DLSS on quality, anti-aliasing on TXAA for the best gaming experience. Update the NVIDIV graphics card driver to the latest version for the best experience.

2. Upgrade FSR from 1.0 to 2.0. If you're not an RTX card, FSR on quality, anti-aliasing on FXAA for the best gameplay experience.

notes.title: 0.93.3711 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Fix the bug where the multiplayer online host dies and cannot be resurrected after entering the next level

notes.title: 0.93.3710 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
1. Fix the bug that the client may fail to move when it is added midway

2. Fix the client can not see the ghost bug

3. Fixed the bug that the monster's size was too large to generate, which would block the progress of the main game

notes.title: Version 0.93.3708 is updated
notes.notes:
Experience improvement:

1. Settings menu -> Gameplay, add a switch that does not automatically pop up talent points

2. Adjust the fabric effect of the player's initial equipment to reduce the lag time

3. Add total volume Settings from the Settings menu

4. Settings menu -> Gameplay, add custom Settings related to the camera, players can adjust their favorite Angle of view

5. Slightly speed up the sword and shield attack animation

6. Slightly speed up the double-blade boning animation

7. Settings menu -> Gameplay, add mouse sensitivity

8. Monster entry on difficulty 3 reduced to 1

9. Monster entry venom has a 1 second damage delay

10. Monster entries for "Laser", "Ice Burst", and "coil" now deal damage with a 1 second delay, and the damage trigger interval has been increased from 0.5 seconds to 1 second

11. Removed the sound effects for the monster entry "Corpse explosion"

12. Settings menu -> Game, add the function of opening LAN, open to create any room except offline can create LAN room

13. Added crash information collector to collect crash information for locating crash bugs



Bug fix:

1. Fixed an issue where the UI would sometimes not close when talking to NPCS in the lobby

2. Fixed an issue where monsters in level 5 of classic mode could easily brush onto walls

3. Fixed lightning Whirlwind, Lightning Shadow, Lightning Blade, lightning Shield and frostbite effects that caused chain lightning to do too much damage

4. Fixed the damage reduction abilities of Flying Sword, Flying Shield, Whirlwind, Greatsword, and shadow remnant with frostbite effects that caused too much damage

5. Fixed an issue with eye of the Abyss's black hole exploding with unlimited damage area

6. Player damage reduction algorithm has been fixed. The problem of frequent removal and addition of player damage reduction will no longer be abnormal

7. Fixed a bug where player health bars would sometimes crash

8. Fixed an issue where the chat screen often appears blank

9. Fixed a bug where other players could still see the blood bar when the client left the game in multiplayer

10. Fixed a bug where the volume of one move of the monster "Hydra" was not controlled
